data: Which component is directly connected to the "Std. align." component and is located to its right?

The question asks for the component that is directly connected to the "Std. align." component and is located to its right. From the caption, we know that the "Std. align." component is part of the "coarse-to-fine aligner" in Figure 2. 

Looking at the figure, the "Std. align." component is connected to the "Refiner" component. The "Refiner" component is indeed located to the right of the "Std. align." component. Therefore, the answer is the "Refiner" component.
